products.name: Gold Mining and Production
products.description: Development and planned extraction of gold from the Livengood Gold Project in Alaska, utilizing large-scale surface mining equipment and a processing plant with crushing, grinding, gravity, and carbon in leach (CIL) circuits. The product is physically mined and processed gold, delivered through conventional mining and milling operations.

products.name: Digital Imaging Systems
products.description: High-performance sensors, cameras, and imaging systems across visible, infrared, ultraviolet, and X-ray spectra, manufactured using advanced semiconductor and MEMS processes for industrial, scientific, medical, aerospace, and defense applications.

products.name: Marine Instrumentation and Underwater Vehicles
products.description: Instruments and systems for underwater measurement, navigation, acoustic imaging, and geological analysis, as well as autonomous and remotely operated underwater vehicles, manufactured for oceanographic, defense, oil and gas, and commercial marine applications.

products.name: Environmental Monitoring and Laboratory Instrumentation
products.description: Instruments and systems for monitoring air and water quality, industrial emissions, and laboratory analysis, including gas and flame detectors, elemental analyzers, chromatography instruments, and laboratory automation systems, produced for environmental, industrial, and pharmaceutical markets.

products.name: Electronic Test and Measurement Equipment
products.description: Oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers, generators, emulators, and related test and measurement solutions, designed and manufactured for use in electronics design, development, and validation across multiple industries including aerospace, automotive, and consumer electronics.

products.name: Harsh Environment Interconnects and Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Electrical and fiber-optic interconnect systems, connectors, cable assemblies, and pressure vessel penetrators engineered for use in subsea, marine, defense, and industrial applications requiring high reliability in harsh environments.

products.name: Aerospace and Defense Electronics
products.description: Electronic and optical components, subsystems, and communications equipment for aircraft, radar, weapon systems, space, and satellite communications, manufactured to meet high performance and reliability standards for commercial and defense customers.

products.name: Aircraft Data and Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Onboard avionics systems, data management hardware, and software applications for civil and military aircraft, developed and integrated to enable efficient data access and connectivity for airlines and defense operators.

products.name: Engineered Systems for Defense, Space, Environmental, and Energy Applications
products.description: Custom systems engineering, integration, advanced technology development, and complex manufacturing solutions, including specialty electronics and electrochemical energy systems, delivered for government and commercial customers in defense, space, environmental, and energy sectors.

products.name: MyoPro Myoelectric Upper Limb Orthosis
products.description: A custom-fabricated, myoelectric-controlled upper limb brace designed to support and restore function in weak or paralyzed arms and hands. The device is manufactured using 3D printing for orthotic components, incorporates advanced signal processing software, non-invasive EMG sensors, small motors, and a lightweight battery, and is fitted and calibrated for each patient by clinical professionals.

products.name: MyoPro Motion G and Motion W Devices
products.description: Variants of the MyoPro orthosis, including the Motion G (with powered grasp) and Motion W (multi-articulated non-powered wrist), both custom-fabricated and incorporating myoelectric control technology. These are manufactured and delivered through direct and channel sales, and are eligible for insurance reimbursement under specific codes.

products.name: MyoPal Pediatric Myoelectric Orthosis
products.description: A planned pediatric version of the MyoPro device, designed for children with upper limb paralysis, including those with birth brachial plexus injuries and cerebral palsy. The device will be custom-fabricated and utilize the same myoelectric control technology as the adult MyoPro.

products.name: MyoGames Digital Training Platform
products.description: A video game-based digital platform provided to patients to help them master the use of their MyoPro device. The platform is used as an adjunct to initial training and ongoing therapy, delivered digitally for home use.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of residential mortgage loans, including 1-4 family and multifamily properties, both for sale in the secondary market and for retention in the loan portfolio. Loans are produced through in-person and referral channels, using standardized documentation and underwriting, and may be sold or held for investment.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate such as retail stores, office spaces, warehouses, industrial buildings, and farm properties. Loans are typically larger, require in-depth underwriting, and are secured by property appraisals and guarantees, with both fixed and variable rate options.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for residential and commercial construction, including speculative construction and land development. These loans are short- to medium-term, require periodic inspections, and are disbursed in increments as construction progresses.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit to businesses, secured by inventory, accounts receivable, equipment, and sometimes real estate. Includes both term loans and revolving credit, with underwriting based on business and guarantor financials.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering of various consumer loans, including automobile and truck loans, home equity loans, home improvement loans, boat loans, mobile home loans, and unsecured loans. Loans are originated internally, with fixed or variable rates and terms up to ten years.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provision of a broad selection of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including checking, NOW, money market, savings, certificates of deposit, and retirement savings plans. Accounts are offered through physical branches and digital channels, with varying terms and interest rates.

products.name: Mortgage Banking (Loan Sales and Servicing)
products.description: Origination and sale of mortgage loans in the secondary market, including management of commitments and recognition of gains on sale. Involves compliance with investor standards and may include servicing sold loans.

products.name: Payment Acceptance Services
products.description: Integrated electronic payment processing services for merchants and businesses, including ACH transaction processing, credit and debit card processing, PINless debit, RTP, and e-checks, delivered via online portals, APIs, and physical or virtual terminals. Requires regulated infrastructure, direct bank sponsorships, and proprietary cloud-based technology.

products.name: Payment Facilitation Platform (PayFac)
products.description: A technology platform ('PayFac-in-a-Box') enabling software and app developers to integrate and monetize payment acceptance for downstream clients, offering real-time merchant enrollment and access to multiple payment methods through a unified API. Delivered digitally and requires regulated infrastructure and technology integration.

products.name: Prepaid and Incentive Card Services
products.description: Issuance and management of customizable prepaid debit card programs (reloadable, incentive, promotional, corporate, government disbursement, and consumer cards), including physical and virtual cards, wearable device integration, and mobile wallet provisioning. Delivered via proprietary platforms in partnership with banks and requires regulated infrastructure and card network integration.

products.name: Electronic Bill Presentment and Payment (EBPP) Services
products.description: Digital solutions for electronic bill presentment, payment, and document management, allowing businesses to create, distribute, and receive payments for bills online. Delivered via proprietary cloud-based platforms and APIs, often integrated with payment processing services.

products.name: Printing and Mailing Services
products.description: Outsourced document design, printing, mailing, and electronic delivery services for high-volume customers, including utilities, financial institutions, and government agencies. Requires physical manufacturing, investment in printing equipment, and integration with mail and logistics providers.

products.name: Expense Management and Fund Management Solutions
products.description: Technology solutions for corporate expense management and fund tracking, integrated with ERP systems, enabling clients to manage payments, send invoices, and reconcile transactions using various payment channels. Delivered digitally and integrated with existing payment and billing products.

products.name: Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities (RMBS) Investments
products.description: Investments in residential mortgage-backed securities, including Agency RMBS, residential mortgage pass-through certificates, collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs), and to a lesser extent, private label and GSE risk-sharing securities. These are acquired and managed as financial assets, typically using leverage and hedging strategies, and are delivered digitally through financial markets.

products.name: Servicing Related Assets (including Mortgage Servicing Rights and Excess MSRs)
products.description: Acquisition and management of servicing related assets, primarily mortgage servicing rights (MSRs) and Excess MSRs, which are acquired from third-party servicers and managed through subsidiaries. These assets generate cash flows from servicing fees and are held and transferred among company subsidiaries, with servicing functions outsourced to subservicers.

products.name: Merchant Payment Processing Services
products.description: Comprehensive payment processing solutions for merchants, including in-store, online, and mobile payment acceptance for debit cards, credit cards, and other electronic payments. Delivered via proprietary digital platforms and infrastructure, targeting small and medium-sized businesses.

products.name: B2B Payment and Treasury Management Solutions
products.description: Automated accounts receivable and payable solutions, including remittance and lockbox processing, remote deposit capture, cash application, payment acceptance, and integrated disbursement services. Delivered through proprietary software platforms and automation technologies to streamline business payment workflows.

products.name: Data-Driven Marketing and Analytics Services
products.description: Data analytics and targeted marketing campaign services for business-to-business and business-to-consumer clients, leveraging proprietary data repositories and advanced analytics delivered via cloud-based platforms. Includes marketing data aggregation, campaign design, and execution.

products.name: Printed Checks
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of business and personal checks for consumers and businesses, utilizing both direct and financial institution sales channels. Production relies on specialized print manufacturing infrastructure and secure processes.

products.name: Business Forms and Essentials
products.description: Production and distribution of printed business forms, envelopes, labels, stationery, deposit tickets, and related business essentials. Manufactured using print facilities and distributed through direct and partner channels.

products.name: Promotional Products and Branded Solutions
products.description: Provision of branded promotional products, custom print, apparel, and digital storefront solutions to support client marketing and relationship-building efforts. Sourced from external manufacturers and delivered through both digital and physical channels.

products.name: Other Web-Based Business Solutions
products.description: Web-based services including financial institution profitability reporting and business incorporation services, delivered digitally to business clients and financial institutions.

products.name: Filtered Drinking Water Products
products.description: Manufactures and markets filtered drinking water delivery products such as bottle filling stations, water fountains, water dispensers, and filtered faucets, primarily for institutional, commercial, and residential buildings. These products are physically manufactured, require plumbing integration, and are certified to reduce contaminants like lead and PFAS.

products.name: Water Safety and Control Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells engineered valve and water distribution control products such as backflow preventers, fire system valves, pressure reducing valves, and thermostatic mixing valves for potable and emergency water supply protection in buildings and municipal systems. These are highly specified, regulated, and physically manufactured products.

products.name: Flow Systems Products
products.description: Produces and markets drainage and wastewater management systems including point drains, linear drainage, fixture carriers, chemical drainage, oil and grease interceptors, acid neutralization systems, and remote monitoring systems for storm water, process water, and wastewater applications. These are physically manufactured, engineered systems for commercial, institutional, and industrial use.

products.name: Hygienic and Environmental Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells sensor-operated flush valves, commercial faucets, water-conserving fixtures, integrated plumbing systems, sinks (stainless steel, quartz, fireclay-ceramic, cast iron), restroom partition systems, lockers, and hand dryers for institutional and commercial buildings. These are physically manufactured products focused on hygiene, water conservation, and facility outfitting.

products.name: Connected Water Management Solutions
products.description: Provides digitally connected product solutions and a secure online portal (plumbSMART™) for real-time monitoring of water usage, filter status, and system alerts, enabling facility operations and maintenance staff to optimize productivity and safety. This is a digital service integrated with physical products, delivered via cloud-based platforms.

products.name: Aircraft and Engine Leasing
products.description: Provides highly customized, short-term leases of commercial aircraft and engines, offering turn-key flight equipment tailored to customer needs. Assets are sourced, maintained, and leased until end-of-life, leveraging in-house MRO and USM capabilities.

products.name: Used Serviceable Material (USM) Parts Sales
products.description: Disassembles retired aircraft and engines to harvest and sell used serviceable material (USM) parts as a cost-effective alternative to new OEM parts. Components are inspected, refurbished, and sold to airlines, MROs, and government customers.

products.name: Aircraft and Engine Asset Management Services
products.description: Provides asset management solutions to third-party owners and operators, including optimizing the value of flight equipment through sales, leasing, and end-of-life strategies. Services include market placement, maintenance oversight, and residual value maximization.

products.name: Airframe Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) Services
products.description: Delivers comprehensive nose-to-tail MRO services for commercial aircraft, including airframe maintenance, structural modifications, conversions, flight system upgrades, and disassembly. Services are performed at large U.S.-based hangar facilities.

products.name: Component MRO Services
products.description: Offers specialized maintenance, repair, and overhaul services for aircraft components such as hydraulics, composites, pneumatics, fuel systems, interiors, and landing gear. Work is performed at dedicated component facilities with FAA/EASA certifications.

products.name: Engineered Solutions (Aircraft Modifications and Proprietary Products)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and installs proprietary aircraft modifications and products (e.g., AerSafe®, AerAware®) to enhance performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. Solutions are FAA/EASA certified and may include new parts manufactured under PMA authority.

products.name: Aircraft Storage Services
products.description: Provides long-term storage solutions for up to 650 aircraft in dry-desert conditions, ensuring preservation and maintenance of aircraft during periods of inactivity. Services include storage management and reactivation support.

products.name: Pest Control Services
products.description: Comprehensive pest control services for residential and commercial customers, including assessment, treatment, and prevention of infestations by insects, rodents, and other pests. Delivered through in-person technician visits using regulated pest management products and proprietary scheduling technology.

products.name: Termite Protection Services
products.description: Specialized termite protection programs for residential and commercial properties, utilizing liquid treatments, foam applications, baiting systems, and wood treatments. Services are delivered on-site by trained technicians using regulated chemicals and equipment.

products.name: Wildlife Control Services
products.description: Wildlife control services for residential and commercial customers, including removal and exclusion of nuisance wildlife such as rodents and larger animals. Delivered through in-person technician visits and physical exclusion methods.

products.name: Ancillary Home and Building Services
products.description: Additional services related to pest management, including pest, rodent, and wildlife exclusion, crawlspace encapsulation, moisture remediation, and insulation. Delivered on-site by technicians as add-ons to core pest or termite services.

products.name: Franchise Programs
products.description: Franchise sales and support for pest control, wildlife control, and mosquito control brands, involving the sale of territories, customer contracts, and ongoing royalties. Delivered through contractual agreements and business support to independent franchisees.

products.name: B2B and B2C Events (Trade Shows, Expos, Conferences, Networking Events)
products.description: Emerald produces and organizes live in-person events including trade shows, expos, conferences, executive peer networking events, and business-to-consumer showcases across multiple industry verticals. These events require significant physical planning, venue management, and in-person human labor.

products.name: B2B Digital Media Platforms and Print Publications
products.description: Emerald offers digital media platforms and print publications that provide industry-specific news, insights, education, and analysis, supporting year-round engagement and advertising opportunities. These are produced and delivered digitally and in print, leveraging editorial and content creation teams.

products.name: B2B E-Commerce and Digital Merchandising Solutions (Elastic Platform)
products.description: Emerald provides software-as-a-service e-commerce and digital merchandising solutions, primarily through its Elastic platform, enabling manufacturers and retailers to conduct year-round digital transactions, manage assortments and orders, and access data-driven insights. This is a digital-only, subscription-based offering.

products.name: Imdusiran (AB-729)
products.description: A proprietary, GalNAc-conjugated, subcutaneously-delivered RNA interference (RNAi) therapeutic developed for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B (cHBV). It is manufactured using advanced nucleic acid chemistry and delivered via subcutaneous injection, requiring specialized biopharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: AB-101 (Oral PD-L1 Inhibitor)
products.description: A proprietary oral small-molecule PD-L1 inhibitor designed to activate HBV-specific immune response in patients with chronic hepatitis B. It is produced through chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral medication, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical trial development.

products.name: Lipid Nanoparticle (LNP) Delivery Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary lipid nanoparticle (LNP) technology for the delivery of nucleic acid-based therapeutics, including mRNA and RNAi drugs, to third parties. This is an intellectual property-based product line, generating revenue through licensing agreements, royalties, and litigation settlements rather than physical manufacturing.

products.name: FB102 Monoclonal Antibody Therapeutic
products.description: A proprietary anti-CD122 monoclonal antibody developed for the treatment of autoimmune and autoimmune-related diseases, including celiac disease, non-segmental vitiligo, and alopecia areata. FB102 is produced using biologic manufacturing processes and delivered as an injectable therapeutic following regulatory approval.

products.name: Fish Trading
products.description: Procurement and sale of fish, primarily eels, involving arranging harvest, inspection, and delivery to customer specifications. This is a physical goods business requiring supply chain management and compliance with food safety regulations.

products.name: E-Commerce Agency Services
products.description: Facilitation of third-party product sales, especially foods and kitchen goods, through live-streaming e-commerce platforms as an agent, earning commission revenue without taking control of the goods. This is a digital service business leveraging online platforms.

products.name: Recirculation Aquaculture System (RAS) Design and Consulting
products.description: Design and consulting services for land-based recirculation aquaculture systems (RAS) for fish farming, including advising on manufacture and installation. This is a specialized technical service requiring engineering expertise and regulatory knowledge, but no longer involves physical production of RAS units.

products.name: Anesthetic-Based Therapy for Treatment-Resistant Depression (CYC-126)
products.description: A hospital-based, technology-enabled therapeutic system combining generic intravenous anesthetic agents (propofol and dexmedetomidine) with a personalized delivery and monitoring platform for individualized dosing in treatment-resistant depression. Delivered in clinical settings and requires regulated drug administration and monitoring infrastructure.

products.name: Licensing of Soluble Guanylate Cyclase (sGC) Stimulator Assets
products.description: Out-licensing and monetization of proprietary sGC stimulator drug candidates (such as praliciguat and olinciguat) for further development and commercialization by third parties. Cyclerion receives milestone payments and royalties but does not conduct internal R&D or commercialization for these assets.

products.name: Insurance Broking and Risk Advisory Services
products.description: Comprehensive risk management, insurance broking, insurance program management, and risk consulting services delivered globally to businesses, government entities, and individuals, involving in-person advisory, analytical modeling, and alternative risk financing.

products.name: Reinsurance Broking and Advisory Services
products.description: Specialized reinsurance broking, strategic advisory, actuarial, and analytics solutions for insurance companies and other clients, including treaty and facultative reinsurance, industry loss warranties, and capital markets solutions, delivered through expert intermediaries and digital analytics.

products.name: Business Insurance and Employee Benefits Solutions for Middle Market and Individuals
products.description: Business insurance, employee health and benefits, retirement and wealth management, and private client insurance solutions for mid-market organizations and individuals, delivered through a network of acquired agencies and specialized advisory teams.

products.name: Specialty and Affinity Insurance Program Management
products.description: Underwriting management and distribution of professional liability, catastrophe, and other specialty insurance programs, as well as affinity insurance programs sold through corporate sponsors, using specialized underwriting and distribution models.

products.name: Risk Consulting and Captive Solutions
products.description: Specialist advisory services including risk consulting, captive insurance solutions, and international insurance placement, delivered by expert consultants and supported by analytical tools.

products.name: Health Benefits Brokerage and Consulting
products.description: Advisory and brokerage services for employer-sponsored health programs, including compliance, outsourcing, and benefits management, delivered through consulting teams and digital platforms.

products.name: Retirement and Investment Consulting and Management
products.description: Actuarial, investment consulting, and discretionary investment management services for retirement plans and other investment pools, including management of client assets and provision of investment products, delivered by licensed advisors and digital tools.

products.name: Career and Human Capital Consulting
products.description: Consulting services in employee engagement, skill assessment, executive remuneration, HR effectiveness, and M&A strategy, utilizing proprietary data, analytics, and digital tools to advise organizations on workforce issues.

products.name: Management, Strategic, and Economic Consulting
products.description: Management consulting and advisory services across industries, including strategy, risk, restructuring, AI transformation, climate and sustainability, brand strategy, and economic analysis, delivered by specialized consulting units and expert teams.

products.name: Insurance-Linked Securities and Capital Markets Solutions
products.description: Structuring and placement of insurance-linked securities (e.g., catastrophe bonds, sidecar vehicles), surplus notes, and corporate finance solutions including M&A advice and capital raising, delivered through registered broker-dealer subsidiaries and capital markets teams.

products.name: Strategic Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory services for corporate clients and financial sponsors on mergers and acquisitions, spin-offs, activism defense, contested M&A, joint ventures, minority investments, divestitures, shareholder engagement, governance, and other critical strategic matters. Delivered by experienced professionals through in-person and remote consultations, requiring deep industry knowledge and regulated financial expertise.

products.name: Restructuring and Special Situations Advisory
products.description: Advisory services for liability management, restructurings, special situations, bespoke financings, tort liability resolutions, distressed M&A, and Chapter 11 matters. Delivered by specialized teams with expertise in complex capital structure challenges, involving regulated financial advisory and in-depth client engagement.

products.name: Alternative Asset Advisory and Fundraising Services
products.description: Private fund advisory and fundraising services for a diverse range of investment strategies, including private equity, alternative credit/hedge funds, real estate, directs, and private capital solutions. Delivered through the PJT Park Hill platform, involving regulated placement agent activities and global capital sourcing.

products.name: Geopolitical and Policy Advisory
products.description: Advisory services assisting corporate boards and management teams in navigating changing geopolitical relationships and evolving political landscapes. Delivered by specialized advisors with expertise in global policy and regulatory environments, typically through consultative engagements.

products.name: Entry-Level Homes
products.description: Design, construction, and sale of new entry-level attached and detached homes, primarily built using standardized floor plans and finishes for cost efficiency and rapid delivery. Homes are move-in ready and delivered through in-person sales in multiple U.S. markets.

products.name: Active Adult Homes
products.description: Development and sale of homes in active adult communities, including both open and age-restricted options, leveraging existing floor plans with modifications to meet the needs of active adult buyers. Delivered in amenity-rich communities with a focus on affordability and value.

products.name: Luxury Homes (Terrata Homes)
products.description: Design, construction, and sale of luxury single-family homes under the Terrata Homes brand, featuring preselected high-end features and finishes. Delivered as move-in ready homes in select communities.

products.name: Wholesale Home Sales
products.description: Bulk sale of newly built single-family homes to institutional investors, primarily for use as rental properties. Homes are constructed using the same processes as retail sales and sold through bulk sales agreements.

products.name: Single-Family Home Rentals
products.description: Development, leasing, and management of single-family homes as rental properties in select communities. Homes are built and maintained by the company, generating recurring rental income and may be sold later to investors or individuals.

products.name: Mortgage Brokerage Services
products.description: Provision of mortgage brokerage services to homebuyers through an unconsolidated joint venture, facilitating home financing as part of the home purchase process.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance Services
products.description: Provision of homeowners insurance and related insurance products to homebuyers through an unconsolidated joint venture, offered as an ancillary service during the home buying process.

products.name: Land Sales and Development
products.description: Acquisition, development, and sale of residential home sites and, occasionally, commercial property as part of larger land development projects. Involves converting raw land into finished lots for sale to external parties.

products.name: Digital Instrument Clusters
products.description: Visteon designs and manufactures a full line of instrument clusters, ranging from standard analog gauge clusters to high-resolution, all-digital, fully reconfigurable display-based devices, using advanced display technologies and embedded functionality. These are physically manufactured and integrated into vehicle cockpits.

products.name: Information Displays
products.description: Visteon produces a range of information displays for automotive cockpits, including large, curved, multi-display modules with advanced user interface technologies, touch sensors, and high optical performance. These are physically manufactured and installed in vehicles.

products.name: Infotainment and Connected Car Solutions
products.description: Visteon develops and supplies infotainment systems and connected car platforms, including scalable Android-based infotainment, wireless smartphone integration, and embedded infotainment platforms. These are delivered as integrated hardware and software solutions for vehicles.

products.name: Cockpit Domain Controllers (SmartCore)
products.description: Visteon provides SmartCore, an integrated cockpit domain controller that consolidates multiple cockpit functions (infotainment, instrument cluster, displays) onto a single multi-core chip, supporting advanced graphics, AI workloads, and over-the-air updates. This is a hardware and software system physically integrated into vehicles.

products.name: Automotive AI Software Platform (CognitoAI)
products.description: Visteon offers CognitoAI, an in-house automotive-grade AI software platform for vehicle cockpits, enabling advanced onboard AI capabilities such as natural language interaction and contextual assistance, delivered as embedded software for automotive OEMs.

products.name: Battery Management Systems
products.description: Visteon designs and supplies configurable battery management systems (BMS) for electric and hybrid vehicles, supporting both wired and wireless battery sensing and control, and enabling advanced battery features. These are physical electronic systems integrated into vehicle powertrains.

products.name: High-Voltage Power Electronics
products.description: Visteon manufactures integrated and scalable high-voltage power electronics units, including on-board charging modules and DC-to-DC converters, supporting efficient grid-to-battery power conversion for electric vehicles. These are physical hardware products installed in vehicles.

products.name: Engineering and Software Development Services
products.description: Visteon provides engineering and software development services to automotive OEMs, supporting vehicle architecture design, software and system integration, user interface design, functional safety, cybersecurity, and validation/testing. These are delivered as professional services throughout the vehicle development cycle.

products.name: Private Equity Investment Management
products.description: Management of private equity funds investing in large-scale, control-oriented and thematic investments across sectors and geographies, delivered through limited partnership fund structures and requiring significant financial capital and in-person investment expertise.

products.name: Growth Equity Investment Management
products.description: Management of growth equity and middle market funds investing in earlier-stage or smaller companies, including technology, life sciences, and sports sectors, delivered via fund vehicles and requiring financial capital and sector expertise.

products.name: Impact and ESG Investment Management
products.description: Management of funds focused on impact investing, targeting both financial returns and measurable societal or environmental benefits, including climate, education, and healthcare, delivered through multi-fund platforms and requiring impact assessment and financial structuring.

products.name: Alternative Credit Investment Management
products.description: Management of alternative credit funds investing in private and tradable credit, including direct lending, asset-based finance, distressed debt, CLOs, and multi-asset credit, delivered through closed-end and open-ended fund vehicles and requiring financial structuring and credit analysis.

products.name: Real Estate Investment Management
products.description: Management of real estate funds investing in equity and debt of real estate assets across the U.S., Europe, and Asia, including opportunistic, value-add, core-plus, net lease, and real estate credit strategies, delivered through fund vehicles and requiring asset management and real estate expertise.

products.name: Private Markets Secondaries and Solutions
products.description: Management of funds providing liquidity and solutions in the private markets, including GP-led secondaries, continuation vehicles, and co-investments, delivered through specialized fund structures and requiring expertise in secondary transactions and portfolio construction.

products.name: Digital Infrastructure Investment Management
products.description: Management of funds investing in digital infrastructure assets, primarily wireless communication towers, delivered through specialized fund vehicles and requiring sector-specific expertise and capital deployment for construction and acquisition.

products.name: Capital Markets Advisory and Execution Services
products.description: Provision of debt and equity capital markets advisory, underwriting, and execution services for portfolio companies and third parties, generating fee revenue through structuring, placement, and transaction execution, requiring financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Brake Pads
products.description: Manufacture of highly engineered brake pads for original equipment and aftermarket applications in passenger cars, light commercial vehicles, and electric vehicles, produced in global facilities using advanced automation and custom formulations.

products.name: Shock Absorbers and Damping Technologies
products.description: Design and manufacture of hydraulic and hydro-pneumatic shock absorbers, damping systems, and energy absorption components for automotive, rail, bus, truck, trailer, and defense markets, delivered through both OEM and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Rail Energy Absorption and Suspension Components
products.description: Development and production of impact energy absorption technology, push-pull components, springs, buffers, and crash mitigation equipment for passenger and freight rail, metro, and tram applications, with repair and overhaul services.

products.name: Industrial Pumps
products.description: Design and manufacture of configured-to-order and standards-based centrifugal and positive displacement pumps for industrial, chemical, energy, marine, mining, pharmaceutical, and power generation markets, produced in global manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Industrial Valves
products.description: Manufacture of a broad portfolio of valves including knife-gate, ball, diaphragm, and valve actuators for biopharmaceutical, chemical, mining, power generation, pulp and paper, and general industrial markets, with specialized sensing and control technologies.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services for Pumps and Rotating Equipment
products.description: Provision of replacement parts, maintenance, repair, optimization, and plant services for industrial pumps and rotating equipment, including cryogenic applications, to reduce total cost of ownership for customers in various industries.

products.name: Harsh-Environment Connectors
products.description: Design and manufacture of high-performance, high-reliability connectors (circular, rectangular, RF, fiber optic, micro-miniature) for aerospace, defense, industrial, transportation, medical, and energy markets, produced in global facilities for critical applications.

products.name: Cable Assemblies for Aerospace and Defense
products.description: Production of highly engineered cable assemblies for avionics, sensors, communications, and networking applications in defense and aerospace, leveraging specialized manufacturing and integration capabilities.

products.name: Control Products for Aerospace, Defense, and Industrial Markets
products.description: Manufacture of actuation, flow control, energy absorption, environmental control, and composite component solutions including actuators, valves, pumps, switches, shock absorbers, and isolators for aerospace, defense, and industrial applications.

products.name: Orexin Receptor 2 (OX2R) Agonist Therapeutics
products.description: A pipeline of novel, orally administered small molecule OX2R agonists (including cleminorexton, ORX142, ORX489, and additional candidates) developed through proprietary structure-based drug design and medicinal chemistry, intended to treat sleep-wake disorders (such as narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia) and other neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric disorders. These therapeutics are manufactured via complex medicinal chemistry and delivered as oral pharmaceuticals following clinical development and regulatory approval.

products.name: LockBody Technology Platform Licensing
products.description: Proprietary LockBody technology platform designed to enable the development of conditionally-active antibody drugs (LockBodies) that selectively drive potent immune effector functions in diseased tissue. The platform is licensed to external partners (e.g., Genmab) for research and potential commercialization of antibody-based therapeutics, with Centessa receiving upfront payments, milestones, and royalties. Delivery is via technology transfer and licensing agreements, not direct manufacturing or sale of finished drugs.

products.name: Real Estate Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive facility, property, and portfolio management services for real estate owners and occupiers, including workplace management, project management, and property management, delivered globally through a combination of in-person teams, technology, and third-party vendors.

products.name: Leasing Advisory Services
products.description: Leasing and tenant representation services for property owners and occupiers, including agency leasing, tenant representation, and related advisory and consulting, delivered by local experts and supported by technology and data analytics.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Brokerage and advisory services for real estate capital transactions, including investment sales, debt and equity advisory, loan sales and servicing, and value and risk advisory, combining local market knowledge with global capital access and technology platforms.

products.name: Investment Management
products.description: Global real estate investment management services for institutional and individual clients, offering private and public equity and debt strategies through funds, separate accounts, and co-investments, with a focus on delivering risk-adjusted returns and managing assets across multiple geographies.

products.name: Software and Technology Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms, apps, and technology services for real estate management, including products for building operations, facility management, and data analytics, delivered as subscriptions or professional services.

products.name: Sustainability Services
products.description: Integrated sustainability consulting and management services for real estate clients, including strategy development, execution of sustainability initiatives, and ongoing performance management, delivered by specialized professionals using technology-enabled solutions.

products.name: Gold, Copper, and Silver Concentrates
products.description: Production and sale of gold, copper, and silver concentrates extracted from the CK Gold Project via open-pit mining and on-site processing (crushing, grinding, flotation, and concentrate drying), with final metal extraction performed by third-party smelters.

products.name: Mineral Exploration and Development Services
products.description: Exploration and development of gold and precious metal mining projects, including geological surveys, drilling, and resource estimation, primarily at the Keystone Project (Nevada) and Challis Gold Project (Idaho), with the intent to discover and advance new mineral resources for future extraction or sale.

products.name: Mining Royalties
products.description: Ownership and sale of royalty interests in mining properties, such as the retained net smelter royalty (NSR) on the Maggie Creek project, providing potential future revenue streams from third-party mining operations.

products.name: Oral Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TLANDO and TLANDO XR)
products.description: An orally administered testosterone replacement therapy for adult males with testosterone deficiency, utilizing proprietary lipid-based drug delivery technology. Manufactured as oral capsules and supplied to licensees for commercialization in multiple territories.

products.name: Oral Neuroactive Steroid Therapies for CNS Disorders
products.description: A pipeline of orally delivered neuroactive steroid (NAS) therapeutics targeting central nervous system disorders, including postpartum depression (LPCN 1154), major depressive disorder (LPCN 2201), epilepsy (LPCN 2101), and essential tremor (LPCN 2203), developed using proprietary oral delivery technology.

products.name: Oral Therapy for Obesity Management (LPCN 2401)
products.description: An oral anabolic androgen receptor agonist formulation designed as an adjunct to GLP-1 chronic weight management therapies or as monotherapy post-GLP-1 cessation, aimed at improving body composition and preserving lean mass in obesity management.

products.name: Oral Therapy for Decompensated Cirrhosis (LPCN 1148)
products.description: An oral testosterone laurate prodrug developed for the management of decompensated cirrhosis, aiming to improve muscle mass, reduce decompensation events, and enhance quality of life for patients awaiting liver transplant.

products.name: Oral Hydroxyprogesterone Caproate for Prevention of Preterm Birth (LPCN 1107)
products.description: An oral formulation of hydroxyprogesterone caproate intended to reduce the risk of preterm birth in women with a history of singleton spontaneous preterm birth, developed as a convenient alternative to injectable therapies.

products.name: Construction Management Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, modular software platform that digitizes and centralizes construction project management, enabling collaboration, workflow automation, and data sharing among stakeholders across all phases of construction. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, accessible from any connected device.

products.name: Preconstruction Solutions
products.description: Software tools for the preconstruction phase, including estimating, bid management, 2D/3D takeoff, design coordination, and prequalification, facilitating planning, budgeting, and partner selection. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Project Execution Solutions
products.description: Digital tools for managing project execution, including project management, quality, safety, field scheduling, and closeout, supporting collaboration, compliance, and real-time information sharing on jobsites and offices. Delivered via the cloud platform.

products.name: Resource Management Solutions
products.description: Software for managing workforce, equipment, and materials, including field productivity, workforce planning, equipment management, and materials management, to optimize scheduling, tracking, and profitability. Delivered digitally as part of the platform.

products.name: Financial Management Solutions
products.description: Digital financial tools for construction projects, including project financials, accounting integrations, and payment processing (Procore Pay), providing visibility, cost management, and automated payments between stakeholders. Delivered as part of the platform.

products.name: Agentic AI and Analytics Solutions
products.description: AI-powered features and analytics tools that automate workflows, generate insights, and predict risks across the construction lifecycle, available as embedded or standalone digital solutions within the platform.

products.name: Building Information Modeling (BIM) Tools
products.description: Digital tools enabling field and office users to view, collaborate on, and generate 3D models and 2D drawings, improving planning, coordination, and accuracy in construction projects. Delivered via the platform.

products.name: App Marketplace and Integrations
products.description: A digital marketplace offering third-party software integrations and extensions, allowing customers to connect external applications (e.g., accounting, document management) to the core platform for enhanced functionality.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Optional implementation and ongoing guidance services to support customers in adopting and optimizing the use of the software platform and its solutions. Delivered by in-person or remote human experts.

products.name: Uranium Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and processing of uranium ore through conventional and in-situ recovery (ISR) mining, with final product as natural uranium concentrate (U3O8) sold to utilities and intermediaries for nuclear fuel. Production involves physical mining, chemical processing, and regulated handling of radioactive materials.

products.name: Rare Earth Element (REE) Products
products.description: Production of separated rare earth oxides (including NdPr, Dy, Tb, Sm, Eu, Gd, Y, Lu) from monazite and other feedstocks, using chemical cracking, leaching, and solvent extraction at the White Mesa Mill. Products are sold for use in permanent magnets, electronics, and advanced technologies. Expansion plans include both light and heavy REE separation and future production of REE metals and alloys.

products.name: Heavy Mineral Sands (HMS) Products
products.description: Mining and processing of heavy mineral sands to produce ilmenite, rutile, and zircon concentrates, which are physically separated and sold to third parties for use in titanium dioxide pigment, ceramics, and other industrial applications. Production involves physical mining, mineral separation, and export logistics.

products.name: Vanadium Production and Sales
products.description: Recovery of vanadium pentoxide (V2O5) as a co-product from uranium mining and processing, with product sold primarily for use in steel alloys, chemicals, and energy storage. Production is dependent on market conditions and uses chemical extraction at the Mill.

products.name: Alternate Feed Materials Processing
products.description: Processing of uranium-bearing materials sourced from third parties (not derived from natural ores) at the Mill to recover uranium, thereby recycling valuable resources and reducing waste. This service involves regulated chemical processing and waste management.

products.name: Medical Radioisotope Production (in development)
products.description: Development and planned production of medical radioisotopes (Ra-226, Ra-228) from uranium and REE process streams at the Mill, intended for use in targeted alpha therapy (TAT) cancer treatments. Production involves chemical separation and regulatory compliance for medical applications.

products.name: Branded Footwear
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and distribution of a broad range of branded footwear, including casual, performance outdoor, athletic, work, uniform, safety, and kids' shoes and boots, produced primarily at third-party manufacturing facilities and sold globally through wholesale, retail, and eCommerce channels.

products.name: Branded Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Design, sourcing, marketing, and distribution of branded apparel and accessories, including activewear, performance running apparel, and select lifestyle apparel, as well as accessories such as eyewear, watches, socks, handbags, gloves, and plush toys, produced via third-party manufacturing and sold through retail and eCommerce channels.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licensing of owned and controlled brands (such as Stride Rite®, Hush Puppies®, Wolverine®, Saucony®) to third parties for use on non-footwear products and for regional distribution, generating royalty and licensing revenue.

products.name: Sourcing and Product Development Services
products.description: Provision of consulting services to third parties related to product development, production control, quality assurance, materials procurement, and compliance, earning commission revenue.

products.name: Multi-Brand Direct-to-Consumer Retail
products.description: Operation of retail stores and eCommerce sites selling footwear and apparel from the company's brand portfolio and other brands directly to consumers.

products.name: MIPLYFFA (arimoclomol)
products.description: An orally administered therapy for Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC), a rare neurodegenerative disease. Manufactured as oral capsules, distributed via specialty pharmacy, and requires regulatory approval for commercialization in each market.

products.name: OLPRUVA (sodium phenylbutyrate)
products.description: A proprietary oral suspension formulation of sodium phenylbutyrate for chronic management of certain urea cycle disorders (UCDs). Manufactured as pre-measured, polymer-coated powder envelopes for improved palatability and portability, distributed in the U.S. and licensed for potential commercialization in Europe.

products.name: Celiprolol for Vascular Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (VEDS)
products.description: An investigational oral selective adrenoceptor modulator being developed for the treatment of VEDS in patients with a confirmed type III collagen mutation. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical tablet, currently in Phase 3 clinical trials, not yet approved for commercial sale.

products.name: KP1077 (serdexmethylphenidate)
products.description: A proprietary prodrug of d-methylphenidate being developed as an oral therapy for idiopathic hypersomnia (IH) and narcolepsy. Manufactured as a pharmaceutical product, currently in late-stage clinical development, not yet approved for commercial sale.

products.name: AZSTARYS (serdexmethylphenidate and dexmethylphenidate)
products.description: A once-daily oral capsule for the treatment of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) in patients age six years and older. Manufactured and commercialized by a partner under license, with Zevra receiving royalties and milestone payments on net sales.

products.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Freight Transportation Services
products.description: Regional, inter-regional, and national LTL freight transportation services provided through a network of service centers and a proprietary fleet, involving physical movement of goods using trucks and trailers across North America.

products.name: Expedited Transportation Services
products.description: Time-sensitive freight transportation services offered as part of the LTL network, utilizing specialized scheduling and routing to ensure faster delivery, leveraging the company's physical fleet and logistics systems.

products.name: Container Drayage Services
products.description: Short-distance transportation of shipping containers between ports, rail terminals, and customer locations, using specialized trucks and trailers as a value-added service to support customer supply chains.

products.name: Truckload Brokerage Services
products.description: Arranging full truckload transportation for customers by brokering shipments to third-party carriers, leveraging digital platforms and industry relationships rather than using the company's own fleet.

products.name: Supply Chain Consulting Services
products.description: Advisory services to help customers optimize their supply chain operations, leveraging the company's logistics expertise and technology to provide recommendations and solutions.
